business_summary: Nittetsu Mining Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in mining activities in Japan, rest of Asia, South America, and internationally. It operates through Resources Business, Machinery and Environmental Business, Real Estate Business, and Renewable Energy Business segments. The company offers minerals, including limestone, crushed stone, calcium carbonate, gypsum, chips for pulp, silica rock, quicklime/hydrated lime, and dolomite; fuel-related products, such as petroleum products, coal, and liquefied petroleum gas; fine chemicals comprising specialty papers, fire-retardant, calcium carbonate, asheet paper shoe insoles, and white limestone; metallic minerals, which include electrolytic copper, gold, and silver; and mineral resources, such as materials for steel manufacturing, copper ore, and other materials. It also develops and operates the Atacama copper mine located in the Republic of Chile, South America, as well as smelts electrolytic copper; supplies environmental products comprising polytetsu and tetsuflock wastewater treatment chemicals, and dashace deodorants; and produces environment-related machinery consisting of dust collectors and deodorizing smoke separators, as well as offers powder and fluid-related machines, including elbow-jet submicron particle separator air-classifiers and raw milk inspection agency plating machines. In addition, the company manages, leases, and sells office buildings, condominiums, restaurants, stores, factories, warehouses, parking lots, and other properties. Further, it is involved in the survey and development of geothermal energy; supply and sale of geothermal steam and electricity; and generation of power using solar power generation. The company was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nittetsu Mining Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본, 기타 아시아 지역, 남미 및 국제적으로 광산 활동에 참여하고 있습니다. 자원 사업, 기계 및 환경 사업, 부동산 사업, 신재생 에너지 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 석회석, 쇄석, 탄산칼슘, 석고, 펄프용 칩, 규석, 생석회/수화석회, 백운석 등의 광물을 제공합니다. 석유제품, 석탄, 액화석유가스 등 연료 관련 제품; 특수 종이, 난연제, 탄산칼슘, 종이 신발 안창, 백색 석회석으로 구성된 정밀 화학물질; 전해 구리, 금, 은을 포함하는 금속 광물; 철강 제조용 재료, 구리광석 및 기타 재료와 같은 광물 자원. 또한 남미 칠레공화국에 위치한 아타카마 구리광산을 개발, 운영하고 있으며 전해구리를 제련하고 있습니다. 폴리테츠(polytetsu) 및 테츠플락(tetsulock) 폐수 처리 화학물질과 대시스 탈취제로 구성된 환경 제품을 공급합니다. 집진기, 탈취연기분리기 등 환경 관련 기계를 생산하고 있습니다.
